articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Real-Time Multimodal Reasoning
articles.summary: OpenAI has unveiled GPT-5 Turbo, a significantly faster and more efficient version of its flagship model featuring enhanced real-time audio and video understanding. The model reportedly achieves 40% lower latency than GPT-5 while maintaining benchmark performance. Enterprise customers gain access starting July 7, with broader rollout planned for mid-month.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's AlphaResearch Agent Autonomously Publishes Peer-Reviewed Paper
articles.summary: Google DeepMind announced that its AlphaResearch agentic system has co-authored and submitted a peer-reviewed paper on protein folding dynamics that passed review at Nature Methods. The AI agent independently designed experiments, analyzed results, and wrote the manuscript with minimal human oversight. Researchers caution this raises new questions about authorship standards in academic publishing.

articles.title: Anthropic Releases Constitutional AI 2.0 Framework for Safer Model Alignment
articles.summary: Anthropic has published its updated Constitutional AI 2.0 framework, introducing dynamic rule arbitration that allows models to resolve conflicting safety guidelines more robustly. The company claims the new approach reduces harmful outputs by 62% compared to their previous methodology. The full technical paper and open-source evaluation suite have been released on their research portal.

articles.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio Gains Autonomous Multi-Agent Orchestration Feature
articles.summary: Microsoft has rolled out a major update to Copilot Studio that enables businesses to deploy networks of specialized AI agents that coordinate tasks autonomously across enterprise workflows. The feature includes a visual agent-builder and pre-built connectors for SAP, Salesforce, and ServiceNow. Early enterprise adopters report cutting operational task completion times by over 50%.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Fine to Meta Over Training Data
articles.summary: The newly operational EU AI Office has issued a €800 million fine against Meta, marking the first major enforcement action under the EU AI Act. Regulators allege Meta used improperly consented European user data to train its Llama series of models. Meta has announced it will appeal the decision while pausing new EU-based model training pipelines.

articles.title: Mistral AI Unveils Mistral RAG-X: A Retrieval-Optimized Open Model
articles.summary: Paris-based Mistral AI has released Mistral RAG-X, an open-weight model purpose-built for retrieval-augmented generation pipelines with native support for long-context document grounding up to 512K tokens. The model outperforms GPT-4o on several RAG benchmarks including FRAMES and RGB while remaining fully open-source. Mistral says the release is aimed at enterprise teams building knowledge-intensive applications.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns of Agentic AI Risks in Critical Infrastructure
articles.summary: Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute has released a landmark 200-page report documenting emerging risks from the deployment of autonomous AI agents in power grids, financial systems, and healthcare networks. The report identifies cascading failure scenarios where agent misalignment could propagate across interconnected systems faster than human operators can intervene. Authors are calling for mandatory incident reporting standards before further deployment in these sectors.

articles.title: Apple Intelligence 3.0 Brings On-Device Vision-Language Models to iPhone 18
articles.summary: Apple has previewed Apple Intelligence 3.0, set to ship with iOS 20 and the upcoming iPhone 18, featuring a powerful on-device vision-language model capable of understanding images, PDFs, and screen content without sending data to the cloud. The new system integrates deeply with third-party apps through a revamped SiriKit API that supports natural language task chaining. Analysts say the move signals Apple's intent to compete directly with cloud-based AI assistants on privacy grounds.
